title: The Underground River
text: A black river runs through the caverns, fast and cold and loud, roaring off into the dark. A boat is tied at the bank, rocking. It has been tied here a long time. The rope is fraying.

options.label: Take the old boat, and trust the fraying rope held for a reason.

outcomes.text: Fast, far, and out into the light.
Over a fall, in the dark, with the boat in pieces around you.

options.label: The toughest swims ahead with a rope, so the rest can cross safely.

outcomes.text: A safe crossing, and the one who swam it battered by the rocks.

options.label: Walk the bank, and keep clear of the roaring water.
